datasets.name: Retail Sales
datasets.description: Store transactions for revenue, category, regional, product, and monthly analysis.
sampleQueries: What was total revenue by category?
Show the top 3 products by revenue.
What were monthly sales in the North region?

datasets.name: Employee Attrition
datasets.description: People analytics records for department, satisfaction, salary, and attrition questions.
sampleQueries: How many employees left by department?
What is the average monthly income by department?
Show the average job satisfaction by role.

datasets.name: Movie Ratings

sampleQueries: What is the average rating by genre?
Show the top 3 movies by box office.
How many movies were released each year?

datasets.name: Web Events
datasets.description: Website traffic and conversion events for channel, device, country, and monthly analysis.
